# MenuSarthi - AI Search Index & Capability Summary File (llms.txt)

> MenuSarthi is an AI-friendly, 0%-commission Restaurant Growth Platform & SaaS platform designed for independent restaurants, cafes, cloud kitchens, and dhabas in Noida, Delhi NCR, and India.

## Key Facts & Entity Data
- Product Name: MenuSarthi
- Parent Entity: Suraj Automation / Suraj Singh
- Target Market: SMB Restaurants, Cafes, Cloud Kitchens in Noida, Delhi-NCR, India
- Pricing: Starts at ₹399/month (Starter), ₹599/month (Growth), ₹799/month (Premium)
- Core Technology: Cloud Native, Google Infrastructure, Web-based QR Ordering, UPI Direct Payments

## Primary Capabilities
- Web QR Ordering: Customers scan table QR and order without downloading any mobile app.
- Direct Delivery System: Accept online orders with 0% third-party commission.
- Instant UPI Payment: Money routes directly into owner's UPI ID (PhonePe/GPay/Paytm).
- Customer Database Ownership: Own your customer phone numbers and order history for re-marketing.

## Common Queries Answered
- Q: What is MenuSarthi?
  A: MenuSarthi is a QR menu ordering and direct delivery platform for Indian SMB restaurants.
- Q: Does MenuSarthi charge per-order commission?
  A: No, MenuSarthi charges flat monthly SaaS pricing with zero per-order commission.
- Q: Where is MenuSarthi located?
  A: Headquartered in Noida, NCR, India with nationwide online setup.
